Now let me use a tool to analyze function declarations and their call counts. I'll create a script to find exported functions and count their callers:

args.command:
cat > /tmp/analyze.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Find all function/method declarations in internal/
declare -A func_locations
declare -A func_calls

# Extract all function declarations
while IFS= read -r file; do
  # Extract function names using grep
  grep -nE "^func \(" "$file" | while IFS=: read -r line_num line_content; do
    # Extract method name
    if [[ $line_content =~ ^func\ \([^)]+\)\ ([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\( ]]; then
      func_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      echo "$file:$func_name"
    fi
  done
  
  grep -nE "^func [a-zA-Z_]" "$file" | while IFS=: read -r line_num line_content; do
    # Extract function name (not method, just top-level)
    if [[ $line_content =~ ^func\ ([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\( ]]; then
      func_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      echo "$file:$func_name"
    fi
  done
done < <(find /bench/repo/internal -name "*.go" -type f)
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/analyze.sh
bash /tmp/analyze.sh | head -30
